original_case: Why are equal dice not equal totals?
changed_condition: Now use the same die twice: copy its result instead of rolling independently.
viewer_inference: The totals are two, four, six, eight, ten and twelve, each with probability one sixth. Seven is impossible. Same individual distributions, different dependence, different sum.
resolution: Independent uniform dice have triangular sum counts; copied identical results retain uniform marginals but only even sums.
prerequisite: Operations introduced explicitly in this film
